title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Expands as 18+ Leading Companies Accelerate Drug Development | DelveInsight
author: Delveinsight
description: The obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) therapeutic landscape is rapidly expanding with 18+ companies developing 22+ pipeline drugs across multiple mechanisms of action. Eli Lilly's ZEPBOUND (tirzepatide) became the first FDA-approved pharmacological treatment for OSA in December 2024. Other major players including Apnimed, Amgen, Mosanna Therapeutics, and Incannex Healthcare are advancing late-stage candidates targeting weight loss, neuromuscular function, and airway control through diverse delivery methods.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Achieved first FDA approval for OSA-specific pharmacological treatment (ZEPBOUND/tirzepatide) in December 2024, establishing market leadership and demonstrating successful clinical validation of their dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist approach.

Advanced AD109 to registration phase with FDA acceptance of NDA filing and PDUFA target date of February 28, 2027. Published Phase III SynAIRgy trial results in peer-reviewed journals demonstrating efficacy and mechanism of action.

IHL-42X progressed to Phase II dose-optimization study with positive Phase II RePOSA results showing statistically significant AHI reductions (up to 83%) and exceptional safety profile. Received FDA Fast Track designation in December 2025.
Developing Maridebart cafraglutide in Phase III for OSA, but limited recent developments or milestones reported in the article compared to other competitors.
Lorundrostat received FDA IND clearance for Phase II trial in January 2025, representing early-stage progress but no subsequent clinical data or major milestones reported.
Listed as a key OSA company developing pipeline therapies, but no specific drug candidates, clinical trial updates, or development milestones mentioned in the article.

title: Apnimed Announces Closing of Upsized Initial Public Offering, Including Full Exercise of Underwriters’ Option to Purchase Additional Shares
author: Na
description: Apnimed, Inc. (Nasdaq: APMD) closed its upsized IPO on August 3, 2026, raising $220.8 million gross proceeds by selling 13.8 million shares at $16.00 per share, including full exercise of underwriters' overallotment option. The late-stage clinical pharmaceutical company is focused on developing novel oral therapies for sleep-related breathing diseases, with its lead candidate AD109 having completed two Phase 3 trials for obstructive sleep apnea treatment and a PDUFA goal date of February 28, 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Successful upsized IPO with full exercise of underwriters' overallotment option indicates strong investor demand. Company has advanced clinical development with two completed Phase 3 trials and an upcoming PDUFA decision, positioning it well for potential market entry in a large addressable market for sleep apnea treatment.
